# The Martian Cylinder Investigation: Sol 3556 Anomaly

> A citizen science and planetary photogrammetry investigation of an anomalous, highly regular cylindrical feature in NASA Curiosity Mastcam imagery (Sol 3556, Paraitepuy Pass, Gale Crater).

## Executive Summary
This project presents an empirical forensic investigation into a solitary, geometrically regular cylindrical object identified in NASA Mars Science Laboratory (*Curiosity*) Mastcam Right 100 mm imagery (PDS Product `3556MR1025170721700585C00`, captured August 7, 2022 at 12:10:25 LTST). Utilizing raw NASA PDS telemetry, CAHVOR camera matrix transformations, solar ephemeris shadow ray-tracing, sub-pixel Sobel gradient edge decoupling, 3D central-perspective photogrammetric modeling, and an empirical null distribution of $N = 20$ background clasts, this study establishes the physical dimensions, orientation, and statistical significance of the feature while demonstrating the methodology of human-guided AI in citizen planetary science.

## Key Technical Findings
- **Instrument**: Curiosity Mastcam Right 100 mm (M-100), focal length $f = 100\text{ mm}$, $f/12$, pixel pitch $7.4\,\mu\text{m}$ ($\text{IFOV} = 0.074\text{ mrad/pixel}$).
- **PDS Product ID**: `3556MR1025170721700585C00` (`DRCL`, `DRCX`, `DRLX`, `DRXX`).
- **Location**: Gale Crater, Paraitepuy Pass, lower Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons), Sol 3556 (Site 96, Drive 2376).
- **Focus & Slant Range**: Focus motor encoder count `2705`, calibrated best focus distance $3.957\text{ m}$ (optical depth-of-field slant range band: $3.63\text{--}4.30\text{ m}$; PDS focus range $3.6\text{--}4.4\text{ m}$).
- **Pixel Scale**: $0.269\text{--}0.318\text{ mm/pixel}$ ($s_\perp$ normal-to-view, nominal $0.293\text{ mm/px}$) to $0.291\text{--}0.344\text{ mm/pixel}$ ($s_{\text{axial}}$ axial foreshortened, nominal $0.317\text{ mm/px}$).
- **Physical Dimensions**:
  - **Transverse Diameter ($D$)**: $11.0 \pm 1.2\text{ mm}$ nominal best estimate ($9.1\text{--}12.0\text{ mm}$ normal silhouette envelope across DoF; $10.8\text{--}12.5\text{ mm}$ 3D axial scale; full physical envelope $9.1\text{--}12.5\text{ mm}$).
  - **Total Exposed Length ($L$)**: $35 \pm 2\text{ mm}$ ($32.0\text{--}37.9\text{ mm}$ envelope; nominal $34.87\text{ mm}$ sub-pixel fit across $110\text{ px}$).
  - **Length-to-Diameter Aspect Ratio ($L/D$)**: $3.24 : 1$ ($110\text{ px} \times 34\text{ px}$).
  - **End-Cap Circularity ($b/a$)**: $0.9335$ (matching 3D viewing foreshortening $\cos\beta$ to within $1.8^\circ$).
  - **Generator Parallelism ($R^2$)**: $0.9985$ ($\Delta\theta < 0.7^\circ$).
- **Solar Ephemeris & Shadow Mensuration**:
  - Solar elevation $\theta_\odot = 69.8224^\circ$, solar azimuth $\phi_\odot = 186.8169^\circ$ (shadow compression factor $\cot(69.8224^\circ) = 0.3675$).
  - Projected 2D image-plane shadow vector $+23.3728^\circ$; measured ground cast shadow $3.11 \pm 0.22\text{ mm}$ ($9.8 \pm 0.7\text{ px}$), matching the $8.46 \pm 0.60\text{ mm}$ exposed vertical relief ($66.5\%$ exposed, $33.5\%$ buried).
- **Statistical Controls ($N = 20$ Surrounding Clasts)**:
  - Natural clast circularity: $\mu = 0.829 \pm 0.100$ ($\pm 0.102$ sample SD; cylinder $z = +1.05\,\sigma$, $p = 0.15$).
  - Natural clast aspect ratio: $\mu = 1.23 \pm 0.16$ ($1.226 \pm 0.167$ sample SD; cylinder $3.24:1$ is $+12.06\,\sigma$ sample SD / $+12.56\,\sigma$ tabulated; distribution-free Cantelli bound $p < 0.0069$; empirical rank $1/21 = 0.0476$).
  - Natural clast generator parallelism: $\overline{R^2} = 0.104 \pm 0.081$ ($\pm 0.084$ sample SD, $\max = 0.271$; cylinder $0.9985$ is $+10.70\,\sigma$ sample SD / $+10.97\,\sigma$ population SD; distribution-free Cantelli bound $p < 0.0087$; empirical rank $1/21 = 0.0476$).
- **Three Candidate Hypotheses**:
  1. *Mission Hardware or EDL Debris*: Constrained by the $28.4\text{ km}$ traverse ($13\text{--}15\text{ km}$ direct air line) from Bradbury Landing, absence of impact/shearing deformation, and an $80\text{--}320\text{ Earth year}$ ($80\text{--}200\text{ yr}$ for $2.0\text{ mm}$ vertical burial; $128\text{--}320\text{ yr}$ for $3.2\text{ mm}$ chord) passive dust sedimentation clock.
  2. *Aeolian Ventifact or Diagenetic Concretion*: Inconsistent with directional aeolian abrasion and isotropic nodule precipitation ($+10.97\,\sigma$ generator parallelism and $+12.56\,\sigma$ aspect ratio outlier).
  3. *Manufactured Artifact of Unconfirmed Provenance*: Testable via in-situ MAHLI micro-imaging ($14\text{--}20\,\mu\text{m/pixel}$) and ChemCam LIBS elemental spectroscopy.

## Primary Documentation & Research Files
- [Main Essay & Monograph](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/): Full longform multimedia essay on the historical JPL heritage (Richard "Sam" Bogner), human-AI collaboration methodology, and photogrammetry results.
- [Technical Paper (PDF)](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/martian_cylinder_paper.pdf): Formal scientific paper formatted in LaTeX with equations, telemetry tables, error propagation, and verified references.
- [Technical Paper (Markdown)](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/martian_cylinder_paper.md): Full raw Markdown of the formal paper for LLM ingestion and text processing.
- [Citizen Science Article (PDF)](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/citizen_science_article.pdf): Standalone editorial essay and methodology report.
- [Citizen Science Article (Markdown)](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/citizen_science_article.md): Raw Markdown text of the citizen science essay.
- [Interactive 3D Cylinder Studio Tool](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/cylinder-tool/index.html): HTML5 Canvas 3D central-perspective projection tool pre-calibrated to the Sol 3556 cylinder geometry.
- [Reproducible Verification Suite (`reproduce_analysis.py`)](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/reproduce_analysis.py): Standalone Python script verifying all PDS telemetry, optical depth-of-field, solar ray-tracing, Sobel edge fitting, and $N = 20$ control rock statistics directly from the raw data.
- [Raw PDS Label & Telemetry Header](https://cambrianminds.github.io/martian-cylinder/DRXX-metadata.txt): Complete ASCII PDS3 VICAR/ODL metadata dump for Sol 3556 frame `3556MR1025170721700585C00`.
